phenomenon: Steady-state heat conduction (equivalently electrostatic potential) on a unit square with fixed zero temperature on all edges and a prescribed interior heat source.

governing_equations.name: Poisson
governing_equations.weak_form_latex: \int_\Omega \nabla u \cdot \nabla v \, dx = \int_\Omega f v \, dx \quad \forall v \in H_0^1(\Omega)
governing_equations.notes: Constant unit conductivity absorbed into f.

geometry.description: Unit square domain with a single connected boundary.

parameters.notes: Homogeneous isotropic medium; set to 1 for the canonical Poisson form.

scale_considerations.notes: Single-scale, smooth solution; no closure/subgrid model required.
